mentions.name: QuickMDSim
mentions.description: This cloud platform lets researchers run molecular dynamics simulations on GPUs with a simple usage-based pricing model, simplifying setup for materials science problems such as battery electrode performance as an alternative to traditional HPC.
mentions.problem: Setting up molecular simulations is complex and traditionally requires HPC; this simplifies the setup with usage-based cloud GPU pricing.
mentions.audience: Researchers who want to simulate materials science problems like battery electrode performance on GPUs
mentions.source_excerpt:
QuickMDSim - An easy way to run molecular simulations in the cloud: https://quickmdsim.com

This simplifies the setup for researchers who want to simulate materials science problems like battery electrode performance on GPUs with a simple usage-based pricing model instead of traditional HPC
